item.title: When an AI Agent Goes Wrong, Can You Stop It?
item.description: Suppose an AI agent is asked to sort support tickets and look up account details. A ticket contains instructions that lead the agent to export records to an unfamiliar destination. item.title: Operation Endgame Takes Down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC Servers, Seizes 6.4M Stolen Logins
item.description: An international police operation took down servers behind Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC this week. item.title: Critical Red Hat Quay Flaw Lets Attackers Read and Overwrite All Private Container Images in a Registry
item.description: A critical flaw in Red Hat Quay allows an attacker who can access a Quay registry to read and overwrite private container images in every repository.
